mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, ATCH_FILE_ID ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{title}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{writer}, #{atchFileId,jdbcType=CHAR} )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.BOARD_ID, t.TITLE, t.CONTENT, t.WRITER FROM BOARD t WHERE 1=1
AND t.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND t.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND t.WRITER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.BOARD_ID DESC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

AND t.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
